**The 3D tour takes a moment to load. On a desktop browser, use your mouse to explore the

05

BUILDING KIT ASSEMBLY

From the shipping container straight to your foundation, our team of experienced Bamboo Living
Certified Assemblers can quickly assemble your Bamboo Living building package in just a few days.

Plus, by choosing Bamboo Living trained certified assemblers, you’ll receive a 10-year structural
warranty on your home and a 5-year warranty on your shed, giving you peace of mind and confidence in
the durability of our buildings.

06

CONSTRUCTION

Bamboo Living offers flexibility in how you build your new home. You can choose to be your own
owner-builder, work with any general contractor of your choice, or partner with our trusted building
partners and in-house construction team to manage every stage of the process from start to finish.

By choosing an experienced team, you benefit from our deep knowledge of our kits and expertise in
the materials and processes that will best bring your dream building to life.

07

FURNITURE, CABINETRY, & DOORS

Whether you’re looking to furnish your bamboo home or simply want to incorporate beautiful,
eco-friendly furniture into your existing decor, our bespoke bamboo creations are the perfect
choice. Each component of our bamboo furniture, cabinetry, and doors is hand-crafted by experienced
artisans, ensuring that every item is made with the highest level of craftsmanship.

WE BUILD BEAUTIFUL HOMES THAT ARE LOW-MAINTENANCE AND DESIGNED TO LAST A LIFETIME

TERMITE & PEST RESISTANT

Naturally pest-resistant, our bamboo is also pressure-treated with non-toxic borates, creating a
termite and pest resistant environment. From sourcing to assembly, every step of our process is
independently inspected and verified to meet international building codes, ensuring long-lasting
safety.

WORLDWIDE DELIVERY

Each Bamboo Living home is built to order and tailored to fit a wide range of locations. With our
advanced prefabrication methods and the flexibility to customize buildings for any climate, our
homes and structures can be shipped and assembled almost anywhere in the world.

SUPERIOR PERFORMANCE

Bamboo is exceptionally strong, offering the tensile strength of mild steel and the compression
strength of concrete. Our bamboo buildings have proven their resilience, withstanding 200 mph
hurricane winds and a powerful 6.9 earthquake.

INTERNATIONAL STANDARDS

Bamboo Living homes are the first and only Internationally Code Certified bamboo structures in the
world. Build legally and with confidence, no matter where in the world your new home will be.

# COMMERCIAL FLOORING THAT'S MADE FOR MORE

Discover the latest Interface flooring collections for your next project.

[ [Interface Dual Effect and Thread Lightly carpet tile in open office] ][172]
Interface | Carpet Tile

### Crafted Connections

Drawing from textile traditions that endure, Crafted Connections™ combines woven textures, bouclé
tweeds and batik styles into one coordinated collection.
[VIEW COLLECTION][173]
[ [Interface Hearth plank LVT with E615 plank carpet tile in private meeting room] ][174]
Interface | LVT

### Earthen Forms

By tapping into the warmth of natural woodgrain and the cool textures of travertine stone, Earthen
Forms™ brings the great outdoors indoors.
[VIEW COLLECTION][175]
[ [norament castello ed in production cleanroom] ][176]
Interface | nora Rubber

### norament ed

Protection to stand on. And count on. norament® ed flooring discharges static quickly and reliably –
safeguarding people, electronic devices and sensitive equipment.
[VIEW PRODUCTS][177]

## MORE THAN JUST A PRETTY FACE

[Interface Broome Street carpet tile in office with birthday celebration]
[Interface E610 carpet tile with woman seated and looking out a window]

## MADE FOR MORE


It’s flooring—but way more fun, inspiring, and groundbreakingly original.

[ LEARN MORE ][178]

## MADE FOR BIG IDEAS.

## AND NAILING THE DETAILS.

 

From concept to footfall, we put our time, energy and ingenuity into every step.

Then we do it all over again.

[ LEARN MORE ][179]

### BEAUTIFUL DESIGNS.

### AND MORE.

Want to see our favourites? Spoiler alert—it’s hard to pick just one.

[ GET INSPIRED ][180]

### CALL IN THE

### EXPERTS

From initial sketch to final floor, the team at Interface Design Studio knows how to push creativity
further.

[ SEE ALL SERVICES ][181]
[Interface Floor Design Tool Mockup]

### BRING YOUR DESIGNS TO LIFE

Our Floor Design Tool lets your flooring ideas come to life—right here in your browser.

[ TRY THE TOOL ][182]

### CARBON REDUCTIONS, **not offsets**

Absolute emission reduction is critical to meet the climate crisis. Offsets are a distraction from
this goal, and we know the time is now to lead. We're backing up our words with more solutions that
accelerate carbon reduction and storage, rather than offsets.

[LEARN MORE][183]

## WEAVING SUSTAINABILITY INTO EVERYTHING WE CREATE

From recycling initiatives to the first ever carbon negative carpet tile, discover how we’re
changing the game.

### Carbon Reduction

We’re transparent about the carbon impact of your purchase to help you achieve low carbon design.
Our carbon plan is simple: Avoid. Reduce. Store. Inspire.
[Learn More][184]

### Product Transparency

We enlist outside partners to evaluate the environmental and human impacts of our flooring.
[Learn More][185]

### Recycling & Reuse

We have been actively collecting, rehoming and recycling our carpet tiles for more than 20 years.
[Learn More][186]

## EVERY GOOD DESIGN STARTS WITH A SYSTEM

Discover our full system of modular flooring, including resilient flooring products.

[ [Interface Angular Times plank carpet tile in private office] ][187]

### CARPET TILE BENEFITS

Learn how our innovative, modular carpet tile can make your space more beautiful, comfortable,
sustainable and positive.

[LEARN MORE][188]

### NORA® RUBBER BENEFITS

Produced with precision in Germany for more than 70 years, nora by Interface represents the pinnacle
of high-traffic, high-performance flooring.

[LEARN MORE][189]
[ [Interface Heirloom plank LVT in workplace seating area] ][190]

### LUXURY VINYL TILE BENEFITS

Blend hard and soft surfaces together for a custom approach to flooring that meets a diversity of
needs with our best-in-class LVT.
[LEARN MORE][191]
[ [Interface Antiquities carpet tile ] ][192]

### AREA RUGS BENEFITS

Our integrated system of carpet and LVT allow for seamless rug insets, and our carpet tile can float
freely on any hard surface.
[LEARN MORE][193]

New Products

### EXBA18V-80
* High-power tabless cell technology – provides lower inner resistance for reduced battery heating,
  increased power, longer runtime and optimized performance
* Outstanding power and runtime – deliver up to 140% more instantaneous maximum power* and up to
  120% longer runtime** than the core18v® 4 ah battery (gba18v40)
* Bosch-exclusive coolpack™ 2.0 technology – cools the battery and helps provide longer lifetime
  compared to non-coolpack™ bosch 18v batteries

New Products

### GKE18V-20N
* 8 in bar length – delivers a large cutting area to increase efficiency
* Brushless motor – delivers efficient power and a 23.6 ft/s chain speed for fast, consistent
  cutting with extended runtime
* High cuts per charge – for up to 350 cuts per charge with a 18V 4 Ah battery (sold separately)
  when cutting 2”x2” pressure-treated wood

New Products

### GSC18V-16EN
* Efficient brushless motor – provides an equivalent of 700w of corded power for fast, clean cuts
* Lightweight, ergonomic design – with slim, soft grip for enhanced comfort and reduced fatigue
* Robust design – with maintenance-free components for durable use

* High-power tabless cell technology – provides lower inner resistance for reduced battery heating,

* Outstanding power and runtime – deliver up to 140% more instantaneous maximum power* and up to

* Bosch-exclusive coolpack™ 2.0 technology – cools the battery and helps provide longer lifetime
  compared to non-coolpack™ bosch 18v batteries

* 8 in bar length – delivers a large cutting area to increase efficiency
* Brushless motor – delivers efficient power and a 23.6 ft/s chain speed for fast, consistent

* High cuts per charge – for up to 350 cuts per charge with a 18V 4 Ah battery (sold separately)

* Efficient brushless motor – provides an equivalent of 700w of corded power for fast, clean cuts

* Robust design – with maintenance-free components for durable use

1.  [[Image of RITA logo and web address ritaohio.com]][23]
    
    #### [Green City Council Considers Transition to RITA for Municipal Income Tax Administration
    #### ][24]
    
    Posted on June 12, 2026
    
    Green City Council will consider legislation (Ordinance 2026-15) authorizing the City of Green
    to partner with the Regional Income Tax Agency (RITA) for the administration and collection of
    municipal income taxes beginning January 1, 2027. [Read on...][25]
2.  #### [Great Eight Race Series Powered by Toth Buick Kicks-Off its 2026 Season in May ][26]
    
    Posted on May 29, 2026
    
    The 2026 Green Great Eight Race Series, powered by Toth, hits the starting line in May with the
    Air Force Raider Run. This year features nine races from May through November. [Read on...][27]
3.  [[Triangle with a roundabout inside, text reads &#34Arlington Corridor Improvement&#34]][28]
    
    #### [Arlington Road Corridor Improvement Project Set to Begin in June ][29]
    
    Posted on May 13, 2026
    
    The Arlington Road Corridor Improvement Project from Boettler Road to SR 619 is scheduled to
    begin in late June following Green City Council’s approval Tuesday, May 12, of a construction
    contract with Xtreme Elements (Legislation 2026-R17). [Read on...][30]
4.  [[Three men performing on the Central Park Amphitheater stage with purple and blue lights on
    them]][31]
    
    #### [Central Park Summer Celebration Brings Live Music and Entertainment to the Central Park
    #### Amphitheater ][32]
    
    Posted on May 13, 2026
    
    The Central Park Summer Celebration brings live music, movies, food trucks and more to Central
    Park, 1795 Steese Rd, on weekends from June through August. All events are free to attend and
    suited for all ages. [Read on...][33]
5.  [[Children on the Central Park Amphitheater stage and gathered around watching]][34]
    
    #### [Children’s Summer Entertainment Series and Splash Pad Opening ][35]
    
    Posted on May 18, 2026
    
    The City of Green is pleased to announce a summer of family fun at Central Park with live
    entertainment on Wednesday morning, courtesy of the Green Branch Library, and on Thursday
    mornings, hosted by the City of Green. All shows are FREE to attend. [Read on...][36]
6.  [[Woman onstage demonstrating a yoga pose while participants follow]][37]
    
    #### [City of Green Offers Free Yoga-in-the-Park throughout the Summer ][38]
    
    Posted on May 13, 2026
    
    Beginning June 3, yoga instructors from the Cleveland Clinic Akron General Lifestyles will offer
    FREE yoga on Wednesday and Saturday mornings at 9 am in the Central Park Amphitheater, 1795
    Steese Rd. [Read on...][39]
7.  [[NOPEC logo]][40]
    
    #### [City of Green Electric Aggregation Price Decreases with Switch to NOPEC ][41]
    
    Posted on April 16, 2026
    
    NOPEC hosting Information Meeting on April 30 to Answer Questions Starting in April, eligible
    Green residents and small businesses will receive enrollment letters about NOPEC’s electric
    aggregation program for the term beginning in June 2026. [Read on...][42]
8.  [[Arlington Road Improvement Project]][43]
    
    #### [2026 City of Green Street Resurfacing Project in May ][44]
    
    Posted on April 16, 2026

1. # NEWS & ANNOUNCEMENTS
1.  [[Image of RITA logo and web address ritaohio.com]][23]
    
    #### [Green City Council Considers Transition to RITA for Municipal Income Tax Administration
    #### ][24]
    
    Posted on June 12, 2026
    
    Green City Council will consider legislation (Ordinance 2026-15) authorizing the City of Green
    to partner with the Regional Income Tax Agency (RITA) for the administration and collection of
    municipal income taxes beginning January 1, 2027. [Read on...][25]
2.  #### [Great Eight Race Series Powered by Toth Buick Kicks-Off its 2026 Season in May ][26]
    
    Posted on May 29, 2026
    
    The 2026 Green Great Eight Race Series, powered by Toth, hits the starting line in May with the
    Air Force Raider Run. This year features nine races from May through November. [Read on...][27]
3.  [[Triangle with a roundabout inside, text reads &#34Arlington Corridor Improvement&#34]][28]
    
    #### [Arlington Road Corridor Improvement Project Set to Begin in June ][29]
    
    Posted on May 13, 2026
    
    The Arlington Road Corridor Improvement Project from Boettler Road to SR 619 is scheduled to
    begin in late June following Green City Council’s approval Tuesday, May 12, of a construction
    contract with Xtreme Elements (Legislation 2026-R17). [Read on...][30]
4.  [[Three men performing on the Central Park Amphitheater stage with purple and blue lights on
    them]][31]
    
    #### [Central Park Summer Celebration Brings Live Music and Entertainment to the Central Park
    #### Amphitheater ][32]
    
    Posted on May 13, 2026
    
    The Central Park Summer Celebration brings live music, movies, food trucks and more to Central
    Park, 1795 Steese Rd, on weekends from June through August. All events are free to attend and
    suited for all ages. [Read on...][33]
5.  [[Children on the Central Park Amphitheater stage and gathered around watching]][34]
    
    #### [Children’s Summer Entertainment Series and Splash Pad Opening ][35]
    
    Posted on May 18, 2026
    
    The City of Green is pleased to announce a summer of family fun at Central Park with live
    entertainment on Wednesday morning, courtesy of the Green Branch Library, and on Thursday
    mornings, hosted by the City of Green. All shows are FREE to attend. [Read on...][36]
6.  [[Woman onstage demonstrating a yoga pose while participants follow]][37]
    
    #### [City of Green Offers Free Yoga-in-the-Park throughout the Summer ][38]
    
    Posted on May 13, 2026
    
    Beginning June 3, yoga instructors from the Cleveland Clinic Akron General Lifestyles will offer
    FREE yoga on Wednesday and Saturday mornings at 9 am in the Central Park Amphitheater, 1795
    Steese Rd. [Read on...][39]
7.  [[NOPEC logo]][40]
    
    #### [City of Green Electric Aggregation Price Decreases with Switch to NOPEC ][41]
    
    Posted on April 16, 2026
    
    NOPEC hosting Information Meeting on April 30 to Answer Questions Starting in April, eligible
    Green residents and small businesses will receive enrollment letters about NOPEC’s electric
    aggregation program for the term beginning in June 2026. [Read on...][42]
8.  [[Arlington Road Improvement Project]][43]
    
    #### [2026 City of Green Street Resurfacing Project in May ][44]
    
    Posted on April 16, 2026
    
    The following Green neighborhood streets are scheduled to be resurfaced this construction
    season... [Read on...][45]
9.  [[Woman and child shaking the hands of veterans at the City of Green Veterans Day Ceremony]][46]
    
    #### [City of Green Veterans Advisory Commission Announces NEW Veteran-Oriented Community Event
    #### ][47]
    
    Posted on April 8, 2026
    
    The City of Green Veterans Advisory Commission is proud to announce a new veteran-oriented
    community event called Green Veterans Rally Point. This monthly gathering is a chance for
    veterans to reconnect with old friends and meet other veterans in Green. [Read on...][48]
10. [[Fiber installation in a neighborhood]][49]
    
    #### [Lumos Installing Fiber Optic Internet Throughout Green Neighborhoods ][50]
    
    Posted on March 27, 2026
    
    Lumos (T-Mobile) is currently installing a new fiber optic internet network throughout the City
    of Green, including in many Green neighborhoods. Lumos has a permit to work within the utility
    easement right of way in front yards. [Read on...][51]
11. [[Scenic view of families walking Willadale Trail in Boettler Park. Above is thee Arbor Day
    foundation]][52]
    
    #### [City of Green Earns 2025 Tree City USA, Growth Award Recognition From Arbor Day Foundation
    #### ][53]
    
    Posted on March 18, 2026
    
    The Arbor Day Foundation named the City of Green a 2025 Tree City in honor of its commitment to
    plant, grow, and maintain trees to benefit its community. City of Green also received a Growth
    Award for demonstrating improved levels of tree care... [Read on...][54]
12. [[Mayor&#39s Morning Meetup graphic]][55]
    
    #### [Residents are Invited to share ideas with Mayor Yeargin at his 2026 Mayor’s Morning
    #### Meetup. ][56]
    
    Posted on February 20, 2026
    
    New this year, the Mayor invites participants to share in a walk with him at or about 9:40 am at
    each Mayor Morning Meet-up event. [Read on...][57]
13. [[Group of women discuss the building of the Green Middle School at an Inclusion & Belonging
    event]][58]
    
    #### [City of Green Belonging & Connection Committee Hosts First Meeting of the Year: A Year of
    #### Belonging ][59]
    
    Posted on January 21, 2026
    
    The City of Green’s Belonging & Inclusion Committee invites all residents to its first meeting
    of the year on Saturday, January 31 at 9 a.m. at the Central Administration Building, 1755 Town
    Park Blvd. The meeting is free and open to the public. [Read on...][60]
14. [[Green Ohio Logo]][61]
    
    #### [Group of Civic-Minded Residents Sworn in to Review Green’s City Charter ][62]
    
    Posted on January 20, 2026
    
    The Charter Review Commission held their organizational meeting on Wednesday, January 14, 2026
    to swear in the members and elect their Chair Bob Knapp and Vice Chair Kristin Yanko. [Read
    on...][63]

# Color Meanings – Discover the Power and Symbolism Behind Every Hue

[Color Meanings]

Colors play an exceptionally prominent role in our lives. They influence our thinking, inspire our
decision-making, and impact our moods. From causing changes to changing reactions, colors are more
powerful than we think. Depending on our interpretations, they can be used for both good and evil.
Fortunately, we have the power to welcome some colors and shun others. This guide will take you on a
journey through the exciting universe of color meanings.

It’s important to note that not all colors were created equal. Though some shades are similar, that
doesn’t mean they’ll awaken the same emotions. To truly grasp the meaning of color, we must learn to
accept this. It’s also imperative to relinquish some control. Try as we might, we won’t always have
a handle on our emotions. Colors have such a substantial effect on the mind and body, and until we
make our peace with this reality, we’ll remain forever perplexed by inexplicable and random
reactions.

**You can read about each color meaning by clicking the links below:**
1.  [Red][26]
2.  [Orange][27]
3.  [Yellow][28]
4.  [Green][29]
5.  [Turquoise][30]
6.  [Blue][31]
7.  [Purple][32]
8.  [Pink][33]
9.  [Brown][34]
10. [Black][35]
11. [Gray][36]
12. [White][37]

## Recognizing Your Responses

Have you ever noticed a shift in your attitude while surrounded by a particular color? Perhaps
you’ve been overwhelmed with nostalgia while staring at a specific shade. You’ve likely written
these occurrences off as a common human response, but the cause is far more complex than that. Color
psychology teaches us that much of human behavior is dictated by color. When we open our minds to
this possibility, we begin to understand the scope of our perceptions.

## Personal Cognizance

Once we acknowledge that colors influence doings, it makes way for personal interpretations. In
other words, we level the playing field by regaining some control of how we react to colors. You may
realize that the color red triggers anger. To avoid unnecessary bouts of rage, limit your encounters
with this hue. On the other hand, yellow might make you feel cheery and upbeat. If so, introduce
more of this color into your life. With a healthy dose of awareness, you can somewhat manage the
moods and emotions that colors produce.

## Uncovering New Meanings

The psychology behind color is fascinating and ever-expanding. With that said, new meanings are
always coming to light. The more knowledge we acquire, the more informed we become. This prospect
promises great hope for future research.

What’s more, our minds are in a perpetual state of evolvement. In essence, though some colors have
fixed explanations, these findings can always shift. This fact is both unsettling and reassuring. As
researchers continue to delve into the many facets of the color wheel, new information is
continually revealing itself.

## Diversify Your Understandings

While reading these articles, you’ll develop a deeper understanding of what colors mean, how they
make an impression on us, and the ways we perceive them. The notion that colors are so dynamic may
seem absurd to some, but there’s no refuting this truth. This concept often eludes us because we
don’t realize how frequently colors control us. Certain hues can evoke fond memories. Others may
give rise to dreadful feelings.

## An Overview of Color Meanings

To help you discover the celebrated phenomenon of colors, here’s an overview of each color’s
meaning, what it symbolizes, and how it affects human emotion and behavior.

### 1. Red Color Meaning

The color of passion and energy. Red draws attention like no other color and radiates a strong and
powerful energy that motivates us to take action. It is also linked to sexuality and stimulates deep
and intimate passion. Red is ubiquitously used to warn and signal caution and danger.

[Read more about the color red][39]

The color of enthusiasm and emotion. Orange exudes warmth and joy and is considered a fun color that

life and it encourages social communication and creativity. It is a youthful and energetic color.

life and it encourages social communication and creativity. It is a youthful and energetic color.

### 3. Yellow Color Meaning

[[Yellow Color Meaning Infographic][Yellow Color Meaning Infographic]][42]

The color of happiness and optimism. Yellow is a cheerful and energetic color that brings fun and
joy to the world. It makes learning easier as it affects the logical part of the brain, stimulating
mentality and perception. It inspires thought and curiosity and boosts enthusiasm and confidence.

[Read more about the color yellow][43]

### 4. Green Color Meaning

[[Green Color Meaning Infographic][Green Color Meaning Infographic]][44]

The color of harmony and health. Green is a generous, relaxing color that revitalizes our body and
mind. It balances our emotions and leaves us feeling safe and secure. It also gives us hope, with
promises of growth and prosperity, and it provides a little bit of luck to help us along the way.

[Read more about the color green][45]

### 5. Turquoise Color Meaning

[[Turquoise Color Meaning Infographic][Turquoise Color Meaning Infographic]][46]

The color of calmness and clarity. Turquoise stabilizes emotions and increases empathy and
compassion. It emits a cool calming peace, gives us a boost of positive mental energy that improves
concentration and clarifies our mind, and creates a balance that clears the path to spiritual
growth.

[Read more about the color turquoise][47]

### 6. Blue Color Meaning

[[Blue Color Meaning Infographic][Blue Color Meaning Infographic]][48]

The color of trust and loyalty. Blue has a calming and relaxing effect on our psyche, that gives us
peace and makes us feel confident and secure. It dislikes confrontation and too much attention, but
it is an honest, reliable and responsible color and you can always count on its support.

[Read more about the color blue][49]

### 7. Purple Color Meaning

[[Purple Color Meaning Infographic][Purple Color Meaning Infographic]][50]

The color of spirituality and imagination. Purple inspires us to divulge our innermost thoughts,
which enlightens us with wisdom of who we are and encourages spiritual growth. It is often
associated with royalty and luxury, and its mystery and magic sparks creative fantasies.

[Read more about the color purple][51]

### 8. Pink Color Meaning

[[Pink Color Meaning Infographic][Pink Color Meaning Infographic]][52]

The color of love and compassion. Pink is kind and comforting, full of sympathy and compassion, and
makes us feel accepted. Its friendly, playful spirit calms and nurtures us, bringing joy and warmth
into our lives. Pink is also a feminine and intuitive color that is bursting with pure romance.

[Read more about the color pink][53]

### 9. Brown Color Meaning

[[Brown Color Meaning Infographic][Brown Color Meaning Infographic]][54]

The color of stability and reliability. Brown is dependable and comforting. A great counselor and
friend full of wisdom. You can count on its help if you need an honest opinion, support and
protection. It stabilizes us, helps us stay grounded and inspires us to appreciate the simple things
in life.

[Read more about the color brown][55]

### 10. Black Color Meaning

[[Black Color Meaning Infographic][Black Color Meaning Infographic]][56]

The color of power and sophistication. Black is an incredibly strong and intimidating color that
exudes authority and makes us feel secure and protected. Often seen at formal and prestigious
events, this mysterious marvel arouses and seduces our senses with its elegance and sexiness.

[Read more about the color black][57]

### 11. Gray Color Meaning

[[Gray Color Meaning Infographic][Gray Color Meaning Infographic]][58]

The color of compromise and control. Gray is neutral, conservative and unemotional. It is
practically solid as a rock, making it incredibly stable, reliable and calming. It has a peaceful,
relaxing and soothing presence. Gray avoids attention but offers mature, insightful advice to anyone
who asks.

[Read more about the color gray][59]

### 12. White Color Meaning

[[White Color Meaning Infographic][White Color Meaning Infographic]][60]

The color of purity and innocence. White is a true balance of all colors and is associated with
cleanliness, simplicity and perfection. It loves to make others feel good and provides hope and
clarity by refreshing and purifying the mind. It also promotes open-mindedness and self-reflection.

[Read more about the color white][61]

# Color Meanings – Discover the Power and Symbolism Behind Every Hue

[Color Meanings]

Colors play an exceptionally prominent role in our lives. They influence our thinking, inspire our
decision-making, and impact our moods. From causing changes to changing reactions, colors are more
powerful than we think. Depending on our interpretations, they can be used for both good and evil.
Fortunately, we have the power to welcome some colors and shun others. This guide will take you on a
journey through the exciting universe of color meanings.

It’s important to note that not all colors were created equal. Though some shades are similar, that
doesn’t mean they’ll awaken the same emotions. To truly grasp the meaning of color, we must learn to
accept this. It’s also imperative to relinquish some control. Try as we might, we won’t always have
a handle on our emotions. Colors have such a substantial effect on the mind and body, and until we
make our peace with this reality, we’ll remain forever perplexed by inexplicable and random
reactions.

## Recognizing Your Responses

Have you ever noticed a shift in your attitude while surrounded by a particular color? Perhaps
you’ve been overwhelmed with nostalgia while staring at a specific shade. You’ve likely written
these occurrences off as a common human response, but the cause is far more complex than that. Color
psychology teaches us that much of human behavior is dictated by color. When we open our minds to
this possibility, we begin to understand the scope of our perceptions.

## Personal Cognizance

Once we acknowledge that colors influence doings, it makes way for personal interpretations. In
other words, we level the playing field by regaining some control of how we react to colors. You may
realize that the color red triggers anger. To avoid unnecessary bouts of rage, limit your encounters
with this hue. On the other hand, yellow might make you feel cheery and upbeat. If so, introduce
more of this color into your life. With a healthy dose of awareness, you can somewhat manage the
moods and emotions that colors produce.

## Uncovering New Meanings

The psychology behind color is fascinating and ever-expanding. With that said, new meanings are
always coming to light. The more knowledge we acquire, the more informed we become. This prospect
promises great hope for future research.

What’s more, our minds are in a perpetual state of evolvement. In essence, though some colors have
fixed explanations, these findings can always shift. This fact is both unsettling and reassuring. As
researchers continue to delve into the many facets of the color wheel, new information is
continually revealing itself.

## Diversify Your Understandings

While reading these articles, you’ll develop a deeper understanding of what colors mean, how they
make an impression on us, and the ways we perceive them. The notion that colors are so dynamic may
seem absurd to some, but there’s no refuting this truth. This concept often eludes us because we
don’t realize how frequently colors control us. Certain hues can evoke fond memories. Others may
give rise to dreadful feelings.

## An Overview of Color Meanings

To help you discover the celebrated phenomenon of colors, here’s an overview of each color’s
meaning, what it symbolizes, and how it affects human emotion and behavior.

### 1. Red Color Meaning

[[Red Color Meaning Infographic][Red Color Meaning Infographic]][38]

The color of passion and energy. Red draws attention like no other color and radiates a strong and
powerful energy that motivates us to take action. It is also linked to sexuality and stimulates deep
and intimate passion. Red is ubiquitously used to warn and signal caution and danger.

[Read more about the color red][39]

### 2. Orange Color Meaning

[[Orange Color Meaning Infographic][Orange Color Meaning Infographic]][40]

The color of enthusiasm and emotion. Orange exudes warmth and joy and is considered a fun color that
provides emotional strength. It is optimistic and upliftning, adds spontaneity and positivity to
life and it encourages social communication and creativity. It is a youthful and energetic color.

[Read more about the color orange][41]

### 3. Yellow Color Meaning

[[Yellow Color Meaning Infographic][Yellow Color Meaning Infographic]][42]

The color of happiness and optimism. Yellow is a cheerful and energetic color that brings fun and
joy to the world. It makes learning easier as it affects the logical part of the brain, stimulating
mentality and perception. It inspires thought and curiosity and boosts enthusiasm and confidence.

[Read more about the color yellow][43]

### 4. Green Color Meaning

[[Green Color Meaning Infographic][Green Color Meaning Infographic]][44]

The color of harmony and health. Green is a generous, relaxing color that revitalizes our body and
mind. It balances our emotions and leaves us feeling safe and secure. It also gives us hope, with
promises of growth and prosperity, and it provides a little bit of luck to help us along the way.

[Read more about the color green][45]

### 5. Turquoise Color Meaning

[[Turquoise Color Meaning Infographic][Turquoise Color Meaning Infographic]][46]

The color of calmness and clarity. Turquoise stabilizes emotions and increases empathy and
compassion. It emits a cool calming peace, gives us a boost of positive mental energy that improves
concentration and clarifies our mind, and creates a balance that clears the path to spiritual
growth.

[Read more about the color turquoise][47]

### 6. Blue Color Meaning

[[Blue Color Meaning Infographic][Blue Color Meaning Infographic]][48]

The color of trust and loyalty. Blue has a calming and relaxing effect on our psyche, that gives us
peace and makes us feel confident and secure. It dislikes confrontation and too much attention, but
it is an honest, reliable and responsible color and you can always count on its support.

[Read more about the color blue][49]

### 7. Purple Color Meaning

[[Purple Color Meaning Infographic][Purple Color Meaning Infographic]][50]

The color of spirituality and imagination. Purple inspires us to divulge our innermost thoughts,
which enlightens us with wisdom of who we are and encourages spiritual growth. It is often
associated with royalty and luxury, and its mystery and magic sparks creative fantasies.

[Read more about the color purple][51]

### 8. Pink Color Meaning

[[Pink Color Meaning Infographic][Pink Color Meaning Infographic]][52]

The color of love and compassion. Pink is kind and comforting, full of sympathy and compassion, and
makes us feel accepted. Its friendly, playful spirit calms and nurtures us, bringing joy and warmth
into our lives. Pink is also a feminine and intuitive color that is bursting with pure romance.

[Read more about the color pink][53]

### 9. Brown Color Meaning

[[Brown Color Meaning Infographic][Brown Color Meaning Infographic]][54]

The color of stability and reliability. Brown is dependable and comforting. A great counselor and
friend full of wisdom. You can count on its help if you need an honest opinion, support and
protection. It stabilizes us, helps us stay grounded and inspires us to appreciate the simple things
in life.

[Read more about the color brown][55]

### 10. Black Color Meaning

[[Black Color Meaning Infographic][Black Color Meaning Infographic]][56]

The color of power and sophistication. Black is an incredibly strong and intimidating color that
exudes authority and makes us feel secure and protected. Often seen at formal and prestigious
events, this mysterious marvel arouses and seduces our senses with its elegance and sexiness.

[Read more about the color black][57]

### 11. Gray Color Meaning

[[Gray Color Meaning Infographic][Gray Color Meaning Infographic]][58]

The color of compromise and control. Gray is neutral, conservative and unemotional. It is
practically solid as a rock, making it incredibly stable, reliable and calming. It has a peaceful,
relaxing and soothing presence. Gray avoids attention but offers mature, insightful advice to anyone
who asks.

[Read more about the color gray][59]

### 12. White Color Meaning

[[White Color Meaning Infographic][White Color Meaning Infographic]][60]

The color of purity and innocence. White is a true balance of all colors and is associated with
cleanliness, simplicity and perfection. It loves to make others feel good and provides hope and
clarity by refreshing and purifying the mind. It also promotes open-mindedness and self-reflection.

[Read more about the color white][61]

# Color Psychology: A Guide for Designers, Marketers & Students

A good rule of thumb for many Westerners is this: wear black to a funeral. Black, in this context,
signifies solemnity; it’s how we show that we’re grieving and respecting that of those around us.
Weddings, on the other hand, are known for white – but only for the bride! While the bride wears
white to symbolize purity and uphold tradition, wearing white as a guest is often seen as an attempt
at pulling attention away from the ceremony, which can be considered gravely insulting depending on
one’s company.

Wardrobe, of course, is far from the only place in our lives where color comes into play. But the
point still stands: color is vital to the human experience. Through color, we feel; we communicate;
and we heal. Those in advertising use it to sell products; those in schools and offices use it to
increase productivity.

When it comes to communication, color is unbeatable. Unconscious or otherwise, color can evoke
emotions, inspire reactions, and change modes of thinking. It can excite or soothe your mood, raise
or lower your blood pressure, and even whet your appetite! Whether it’s innate or learned, it’s
undeniable that color has a vital impact on how we go about our lives.

With the basics of the color theory under your belt, you can approach the psychology of individual
colors with a bit more nuance. As we’ve established, color is far from just a visual experience; it
can affect your mood, your wants, your reactions, and so on. However, such a powerful tool is wasted
if you don’t know how to use it effectively.

As such, knowing the personality and psychological effects of different colors – including various
shades and tints popular with producers and consumers alike – is vital!

Consider the following list a table of contents of sorts. This will be your point of reference from
which to navigate the depths of color psychology.

## [The Color Psychology of Red][199]

From the start of the rainbow to the ubiquitous advertising for Valentine’s Day, red remains one of
the most evocative colors on the visible spectrum. As a primary color, red is a color entirely its
own – that is to say, no other colors can come together to form a perfect red. In RGB, red is
comprised of 100% red, 0% green, and 0% blue.

rich heritage of our faith. It’s left many church leaders – whether you’re a current pastor, a
church planter, or lay leader – wondering who to turn to as they seek to apply Reformed theology in
today’s world.

[See How We Help][10]

#### **Since 2012, we’ve helped over 450 churches start and strengthen new approaches to the mission
#### and ministry of the Church.**

[Church Planting]

# Current Churches

##### Are you leading a church and looking for a denomination to be a part of? When you join ECO,
##### you get the distinctives of a denomination but the freedom of a network.

[Join ECO][11]

# Current Plants

##### While some leaders try ministry alone, we believe that life in community offers the care and
##### creativity needed to help you fulfill the mission of the Church.

[Start a conversation][12]

### **What Makes ECO Unique?**

##### **You will get the distinctives of a denomination with the freedom of a network.**

##### **You will get to be a part of a community**
##### **that challenges you to constantly grow.**

##### **You will receive resources to help you build flourishing churches.**

##### **You will strengthen your church’s impact based on the needs in your community and world.**

[See How We Help][13]

# ECO was started because we recognized existing methods of ministry were no longer effective in
# today's culture.

The world is a confusing place and churches need a guide to help them innovate. Our
Reformed convictions ground us and guide us as we adapt our methods to reach a shifting culture.

Click below to download *Five Ways We Are Reimagining Church.*

[Get the PDF][14]

## **Ready to strengthen your church’s impact in an ever changing world?**

[1. See How We Help][15]

##### **Church planting, denominational support,** **and ministry resources are what we do.**

[2. Start the Conversation][16]

##### **Discover what partnership with ECO looks like for your church.**

[3. Join ECO][17]

##### **Together we can build flourishing churches that make disciples of Jesus Christ.**

## **You don’t have to abandon your**
## **convictions to effectively reach your** **community.**

[See How We Help][18]

## What are the best home renovation services in New Zealand?

The best home renovation services in New Zealand focus on quality craftsmanship, customer
satisfaction, and adherence to local building regulations. Popular services include kitchen
remodeling, bathroom renovations, outdoor living spaces, whole house renovations, and
energy-efficient upgrades.

▾Expand description

### Kitchen remodeling

Kitchen remodeling involves updating the layout, fixtures, and finishes of your kitchen to enhance
functionality and aesthetics. Key considerations include choosing durable materials, optimizing
storage, and ensuring proper lighting. A typical kitchen remodel in New Zealand can range from NZD
20,000 to NZD 50,000, depending on the scale and quality of materials used.

When planning a kitchen remodel, avoid common pitfalls such as neglecting the workflow triangle
(sink, stove, refrigerator) and underestimating the importance of ventilation. Hiring a qualified
contractor can help streamline the process and ensure compliance with local building codes.

# Custom Home Builder & General Contractor in NJ

***Licensed in New Jersey:** NJ HIC #13VH10907000 | NJ New Home Builder Reg #51766 | Fully bonded
and insured | 40+ years on the Jersey Shore*

Gambrick Construction is a family-owned custom home builder and general contractor based in Point
Pleasant, NJ. We build throughout New Jersey, with concentrated work in **Ocean and Monmouth
County**. We specialize in **luxury custom homes**, **waterfront new construction**, knock-down
rebuilds, **whole-house renovations**, **home additions and add-a-levels**, sunrooms, tiny homes,
custom decks, ADUs, and saunas.

Building at the Jersey Shore demands highly specific engineering. We build for **Exposure D wind
loads**, salt-air corrosion, and strict **FEMA flood zone** requirements. Inland projects prioritize
high-performance energy envelopes and historic review board compliance. We engineer every structure
for its exact environment.

As a Design-Build general contractor, we manage the entire construction process so you don’t have
to. We coordinate directly with top local architects, engineers, and zoning officers to take your
project from the first sketch to the final walkthrough. Whether it is a waterfront rebuild in Bay
Head, a modern home in Brick, or a whole-house renovation in Spring Lake, we handle the complex
regulatory work, including **NJDEP CAFRA permits**, **Base Flood Elevation** engineering, and
**helical pile foundations**, long before construction begins.

[[Custom new home build by Gambrick Construction][Custom new home build by Gambrick
Construction]][63]

## Custom Home Builder

We build luxury custom homes across Bay Head, Mantoloking, Spring Lake, and Sea Girt. Whether
starting with raw land or a knock-down rebuild, we handle the full ground-up construction process.
* [**Custom New Home Construction:**][64] Stick-built luxury homes engineered to local conditions,
  coastal **Exposure D wind loads** on the Shore, high-performance envelopes and historic review
  compliance inland.
* [**Knock-Down Rebuilds:**][65] Full demolition, debris removal, utility disconnects, and ground-up
  reconstruction.
* [**Waterfront Home Builder:**][66] Custom homes on the Manasquan River, Barnegat Bay, and
  oceanfront lots, built to withstand salt, water, and wind.
* [**FEMA-Compliant Builder:**][67] V-Zone and A-Zone construction using deep-driven **helical
  piles**, treated timber pilings, breakaway walls, and engineered flood vents.
* [**Architectural Design-Build:**][68] Floor plans, 3D renderings, and structural engineering
  seamlessly coordinated by our team.
* **Passive House Builder:** Ultra-efficient homes engineered to [**Passive House**][69] and DOE
  Zero Energy Ready standards.
* [**Custom Tiny House Builder:**][70] Permanent, foundation-built luxury micro-homes. We do not
  build temporary structures on wheels; we engineer high-end, code-compliant tiny houses to the same
  coastal standards as our primary builds.

## Home Renovation & House Raising

has an outdated layout, we manage the structural remodeling smaller contractors avoid.

## Service Areas

Green Construction Services is proud to serve Central Florida residential and commercial clients as
an industry-certified, fully-licensed and insured general contractor.

# Our Why

### We exist to bring peace of mind and a sense of relief to our clients by providing
### integrity-driven expertise resulting in quality relationships with our customers.

# Leadership

## Mike Green

Partner

[Read Bio][27]

Roofing

## Mike Green

### Partner


Mike Green has been an owner of Green Construction Services for the past 30 years. Mike oversees the
administrative and accounting functions of the business. He earned his B.A. in Accounting from
Cedarville University in Ohio.

Mike is a State Certified Building Contractor and an expert in his field. He also serves as a
Project Estimator, specializing in remodeling and renovation projects. Mike is a Certified Microbial
Remediation Specialist and is trained in fire and water damage restoration.

On the board of the Polk County Builders Association, Mike is the chairman of the Remodelers
Committee. In this capacity, he serves both the local construction community and county residents.

Mike has spent many years coaching middle and high school soccer at Lakeland Christian School and in
the FYSA (Florida Youth Soccer Association). He is also active at his local church, Heritage Baptist
Church, and serves as a board member there. Mike and his wife, Missy, live in Lakeland. They have
four children.

## Nate Purcell

Partner

[Read Bio][28]

PBP09458

## Nate Purcell

### Partner


Nathan Purcell is a State Certified Building Contractor.

Nate is highly trained in building and restoration, holding IICRC certifications in applied
structural drying (ASD), water damage restoration (WRT), and fire, smoke, and restoration (FSRT). In
addition to this specialized training, Nate has more than 21 years of hands-on experience in the
industry.

When he’s not at work, Nate volunteers at several charitable organizations. He is on the boards of
CWE Missions, KIDZ Outdoors of Central Florida, and Heritage Baptist Church in Lakeland.

Nathan and his wife, Randi, are native Floridians, raising their two children in Polk County.

# Our People are our greatest asset

## Start Your Career with Green

If you’re a highly motivated individual with a great work ethic looking to work with a growing team,
check out our openings.

[Open Positions][29]

# Contact

## Connect With Us

If you would like to discuss your project with one of our specialists, please fill out the form and
we will be in touch shortly.
